episodes.title: Elizabeth Holmes Lets Us See Everything? Selena's Vape Voice and Miley's Bowl Blues
episodes.description: Kempire is here, and we're getting into all the hot topics! First up, I'm breaking down You Can See Everything, the number one movie about Elizabeth Holmes: what was real, what wasn't, and what her real intention was in doing this film. Selena Gomez opens up about vaping and how it's affected her voice, and Miley Cyrus addresses fans about her lack of enthusiasm at the Hollywood Bowl. Then Kempire joins me for Real Housewives of Salt Lake City. I remind you my new song drops this Thursday, October 22nd, and ask: am I bothered by Housewives who can't sing becoming pop stars? Plus, what did Bronwyn pay her boyfriend, and was he even a boyfriend at all? We dig into Real Housewives of New York and the Jeffrey Epstein of it all, and what Emily really meant when she said Shane was watching a how-to video on pleasing women down there on RHOC. And finally, the most explosive show right now, Real Housewives of Potomac: Dr. Wendy and her husband Eddie's fraud charges, and Tia's husband getting caught with a dating profile. episodes.title: The Comedian, the Cult, and Painting Red Flags Green
episodes.description:
Today I'm sitting down with my old friend, the incredibly talented standup comic, author, and producer Craig Shoemaker! We waste no time diving into his wildest personal drama, unpacking the saga of his marriage to a "hippie" who ended up lured into a full-blown cult. While Craig shares his perspective on whether it was a long-term grift or an extreme spiritual derailment, I give him some tough love and a female perspective on painting red flags green. Plus, we trade hilarious behind-the-scenes standup notes, discuss comic couples, and he gives me the ultimate inside scoop on what my husband Peter actually says about me out on the golf course!
